source_text: Klagel. Jerem. 2, 17. Οὐδέν, φησίν, ἐξ ἐαυτῶν ἐποίησαν οἱ πολέμιοι· θεῷ γὰρ ἐδόκει καὶ γέγονεν. διόπερ ἔλεγε καὶ Ναβουζαρδάν· κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐλάλησε τὰ κακὰ ταῦτα εἰς τὸν τόπον τοῦτον, καὶ ἐπήγαγε κύριος, ὅτι ἡμάρτετε αὐτῷ( πᾶς οὖν ἀπιστῶν τῇ κρίσει τῶν ῥημάτων τούτων ἀκούσεται. πάντες μὲν οὖν οἱ προφῆται ταῦτα προὔλεγον, ἐξ ἡμερῶν δὲ ἀρχαίων ὸ Μωσῆς ἐν τῷ Δευτερονομίῳ ταῦτα προεμήνυσεν.
pass_a_gloss: [Pass A] Nothing, she says, did the enemies do from themselves; for it seemed good to God and has come to be. For which reason Nebuzaradan also was saying: “the Lord your God has spoken these evils unto this place, and the Lord has brought them on, because you sinned against him.” Everyone, then, who disbelieves the judgment will hear these words. All the prophets, then, were foretelling these things, and from ancient days Moses in Deuteronomy announced these things beforehand.
pass_b_english: Nothing, she says, did the enemies do from themselves; for it seemed good to God and has come to be. For which reason Nebuzaradan also was saying: “the Lord your God has spoken these evils unto this place, and the Lord has brought them on, because you sinned against him.” (Lamentations 2:17) Everyone, then, who disbelieves the judgment will hear these words. All the prophets, then, were foretelling these things, and from ancient days Moses in Deuteronomy announced these things beforehand (Jeremiah 40:2–3).
